name: Radioiodine I-131 (RAI-avid metastatic DTC)
cyclesNote: a single therapeutic administration per course; courses are repeated at roughly 6 to 12 month intervals while metastases stay iodine-avid and responding. Nuclear medicine sets the individual activity (empiric fixed activity, or dosimetry-guided in high-risk / diffuse pulmonary disease).

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE draft protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

histology: iodine-avid distant-metastatic differentiated thyroid carcinoma (papillary / follicular / oncocytic)

premedications.name: TSH stimulation
premedications.notes: raise TSH before dosing, either by thyroid-hormone withdrawal (stop levothyroxine, or switch to liothyronine then stop) targeting TSH above about 30 mIU/L, or by recombinant human TSH (thyrotropin alfa) on the two days before the activity.

premedications.name: Low-iodine diet
premedications.notes: approximately 1 to 2 weeks of a low-iodine diet beforehand; avoid recent iodinated contrast and amiodarone, which block uptake.

supportiveCare: confirm iodine avidity on a diagnostic or post-therapy scan before relying on radioiodine in metastatic disease.
obtain a pregnancy test in people of child-bearing potential; radioiodine is contraindicated in pregnancy and lactation.
hydrate well, use antiemetics, and encourage frequent voiding and salivary stimulation (sour candy / sialogogues) to limit sialadenitis and bladder / gonadal dose.
radiation-safety precautions and isolation per local regulations after administration.

continue TSH suppression (levothyroxine to TSH below 0.1 mIU/L) between treatments; add directed local therapy and a bone-modifying agent for symptomatic, dominant, or CNS / weight-bearing bone lesions.
monitoring: post-therapy whole-body I-131 scan 5 to 8 days after the activity to map avid disease
thyroglobulin and anti-thyroglobulin antibody trend as the response marker
CBC (marrow suppression with repeated / high cumulative activity)
salivary, lacrimal, and pulmonary (fibrosis with diffuse lung metastases) late effects

doseModificationRules.condition: high cumulative lifetime I-131 activity (commonly reviewed above about 22 GBq / 600 mCi) or diffuse pulmonary metastases
doseModificationRules.text: Use dosimetry to cap the whole-body / lung retention (keep blood dose within accepted limits and 48-hour lung retention low) and review cumulative marrow and pulmonary-fibrosis risk before re-treating. Nuclear medicine and the physician decide.

drugs.name: Iodine-131 (sodium iodide)
drugs.notes: Therapeutic sodium iodide I-131, single oral activity after TSH stimulation and a low-iodine diet. A representative empiric fixed activity for iodine-avid distant metastases is about 5.5 GBq (150 mCi), commonly in the 3.7 to 7.4 GBq (100 to 200 mCi) range; dosimetry-guided activity is preferred for diffuse pulmonary or high-burden disease and to respect blood / lung retention limits. A weight-based estimate of roughly 74 MBq/kg (2 mCi/kg) is sometimes used. Nuclear medicine sets and administers the individual activity. Own wording - not a verbatim source copy.
